spans.s:
1idám [501--2 --forms made from four
stems, á and aná, í and imá, those from á
being often unaccented, see 74^9 N.], pron.
this, this here, τόδε, e. g. 20^9, 86^10, 87^8;
contrasted w. asau, ‘that one,’ 103^7; asmin
loke, in this world, 66^12; without loke and
contrasted w. amutra, 103^8; idaṃ viśvam
bhuvanam, this whole world, 85^12; idaṃ
sarvam, this entire (world), 63^21; so 66^19;
so idam, τὸ πᾶν, 5615, 17; iyam pṛthivī,
this earth, 10^10; iyam alone, this earth,
931, 2; --refers very often, like τάδε, to something
following (just as etad and ταῦτα to
something preceding), e. g. 13^22, 26^7, 45^14,
51^6; occasionally refers to something immediately
preceding, e. g. 10^17, 24^9, 74^12, 79^4;
--joined w. pronouns: ko 'yam āyāti, who
comes here ? 27^12; yo 'yaṃ dṛśyate,
which is seen here, 46^17; mām imam, me
here, 76^16; nom. to be rendered here is or
are, 56^1, 4^21; imau vātas, blow hither,
90^12. [cf. Lat. i-d, Goth. i-ta, Ger. es, ‘it.’]
